step: P9-R1 (a): entries.mjs names its own path for the build's watch list by an explicit file URL (`new URL("./entries.mjs", import.meta.url)`), the same path, which F-1 reads as a new-url edge with a span; the bare `fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)` is an edge with no span, and the floor engine refuses to move a file that holds one (S74c moves entries.mjs into lib/tree/)

hunks:
return [join(root, recordPath(root)), fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)];
    return [join(root, recordPath(root)), fileURLToPath(new URL("./entries.mjs", import.meta.url))];

reasons.why: the watch list names this reader by an explicit URL the floor can carry through a move
